questions.question: What challenge does God give about Jerusalem in Jeremiah 5?
options: Tear down each and every single idol, and he will surely spare the whole wide land
Bring a full thousand bulls to the altar, and he will at last relent
Find one person who does justice and seeks truth, and he will pardon the city
Send all of the false prophets away, and he will yet show them mercy
questions.answer: Find one person who does justice and seeks truth, and he will pardon the city

questions.question: How does Jeremiah 5 describe the prophets and priests?
options: The prophets prophesy falsely and the priests rule at their direction
The prophets warn the people truly but the people simply will not hear
The prophets and the priests alike have all fled away from the city
The prophets are faithful and true but the priests are utterly corrupt
questions.answer: The prophets prophesy falsely and the priests rule at their direction

questions.question: Jeremiah 5 says the people have a stubborn and rebellious heart and do not fear the LORD.
See if you can find a single person, anyone who acts _____ and seeks the truth.
